featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Tibo pre-announced a key change ahead of DevDay: Pro $200 subscriptions reopen to new subscribers tomorrow, but usage accounting changes so that, by his own math, it nets out to about half the API-dollar equivalent of the old Pro $200 plan. His rationale: no return of the 5-hour limit so weekly usage can be spent whenever; subscribers keep getting more value per dollar as models get more efficient and API prices fall (GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna were cut to 50% of their previous price this week); no…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Tibo 在 DevDay 前夜提前放出一个重要变更：Pro $200 订阅明天重新对新用户开放，但用量计算方式同步调整——按他自己的说法，折算下来相当于旧 Pro $200 方案一半的 API 等价额度。他给出的理由有四点：承诺不再恢复 5 小时限额，周额度可以随时用满；订阅用户会随着模型效率提升和 API 降价持续获得更多单位价值（本周 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 已降价 50%）；不想为了让订阅“看起来很划算”而人为抬高 API 标价；明天还会加入不占用额度的新订阅权益。这是一次典型的“先交代坏消息，再发布好消息”的预期管理。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie shared early-access results for Sonnet 5.5 on Box's complex enterprise-content eval: +4 points overall on the hardest tests, about 2.4× faster to a finished deliverable on 12% fewer tokens. By vertical: +18 pts Financial Services, +7 Legal, +8 Life Sciences, +7 Public Sector. Highlights include catching miscalculated interest totals and mispriced options in a due-diligence deal book (~61% faster), refusing to invent a "standard" market benchmark in a lease review and flagging what was actually…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 分享了 Sonnet 5.5 在 Box Agent 企业知识工作评测上的早期测试结果：最难测试集整体提升 4 分，但交付完成速度快约 2.4 倍、token 少 12%。分行业看，金融服务 +18、法律 +7、生命科学 +8、公共部门 +7 个百分点。具体案例包括：尽调审阅中识别出交易手册里算错的利息总额和定价错误的期权（快约 61%）；租赁合同审阅中拒绝编造“市场标准”条款，而是指出合同真正缺失的部分；从原始数据正确计算两组试验的样本标准差（Sonnet 5 几乎全错）。Box AI Studio 即将支持用 Sonnet 5.5 构建 Agent。

items.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
items.summaryEn: Claude Code lead Boris Cherny showcased Sonnet 5.5 fixing a bug inside Claude Code: 30% faster and 30% less usage.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 用一段 Sonnet 5.5 在 Claude Code 里修 bug 的演示宣布新模型：速度快 30%、用量少 30%。这条是今天互动量最高的产品发布推文之一。

items.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic Claude Code & Cowork 产品
items.summaryEn: Claude Code and Cowork PM Cat Wu added that Sonnet 5.5 gets ~30% more tasks done than Sonnet 5 in Claude Code, and because it's smarter it needs fewer tokens for the same work. In a demo raking a yard of leaves via tool calls, it was 24s faster than Sonnet 5 with 6K fewer tokens.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 产品负责人 Cat Wu 补充了官方数据：在 Claude Code 中，Sonnet 5.5 比 Sonnet 5 多完成约 30% 的任务，因为更聪明，完成同样工作所需 token 更少。演示里模型通过工具调用“耙完一院子落叶”，比 Sonnet 5 快 24 秒、少用 6K token。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from the Claude Code team made two points: it's now basically impossible to just "show someone your prompt," because results hinge on references, skills and examples — he often has his agent look at three other repos first, search the web, and use other AI APIs. And on token-cost concerns around higher-level abstractions like projects, claude tag and dynamic workflows, he argues Sonnet and Opus 5.5 make that level of intelligence widely affordable, recommending Sonnet 5.5 for building workflows.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 谈了两点：第一，现在几乎不可能有人“直接给你看他的 prompt”了，因为效果全靠引用、skills 和示例——他常让 agent 先看自己的另外 3 个 repo、搜网上参考、调用其他 AI API；第二，谈到 projects、claude tag、动态工作流这类更高层抽象时常被质疑 token 成本，他认为有了 Sonnet 和 Opus 5.5，这种智能应该变得足够可及，并建议搭工作流时特别试试 Sonnet 5.5。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper's first take on Sonnet 5.5: dramatically improved writing, beating Opus 5.5 in his testing; Astra remains his favorite for writing, but Sonnet 5.5 wins on revision tasks. Faster and cheaper than Opus 5.5, it's Kieran's pick for quick iterative coding and design, though some colleagues feel there's no room for mid-tier models in their stack anymore. He also noted that of every DevDay since 2023, this one has by far the most OpenAI launches.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 给出 Sonnet 5.5 初步体感：写作能力大幅提升，他的测试中甚至优于 Opus 5.5；写作首选仍是 Astra，但修改类任务 Sonnet 5.5 更强。它比 Opus 5.5 更快更便宜，是团队成员 Kieran 做快速迭代编码和设计的首选；但也有同事认为自己的技术栈里已经没有中档模型的位置了。他还表示，从 2023 年起每届 OpenAI DevDay 都参加，这次是发布数量最多的一次。

items.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic Research
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's Alex Albert said Sonnet 5.5 has the same feel he liked in Opus 5.5 — clear writing, very fast, and a major capability jump over Sonnet 5, making it a great model to iterate with.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 的 Alex Albert 评价 Sonnet 5.5 延续了他喜欢的 Opus 5.5 的手感：表达清晰、速度很快，相比 Sonnet 5 是一次大的能力跃升，非常适合用来快速迭代。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: The official Claude account showcased community work with Sonnet 5.5: a same-prompt bouncing-ball physics comparison between Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 5.5, and pixel-art forest creatures with every frame drawn in code, while asking what users are exploring with the new model.
items.insightZh: Claude 官方账号晒出社区用 Sonnet 5.5 做的案例：同一 prompt 下 Sonnet 5 与 Sonnet 5.5 的弹球物理对比测试，以及每一帧都由代码绘制的像素风森林生物动画，并征集用户正在用 Sonnet 5.5 探索的方向。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang built a playable StarCraft level with Sonnet 5.5 — play Terran defending against the Zerg, building Marines, Siege Tanks and Battlecruisers, with SC2 models from Sketchfab and music from Suno; Sonnet even made the sizzle reel. He also pushed back on X's fickle "OpenAI is getting mogged by Claude 5.5" / "Anthropic is cooked by Codex" swings, saying he's just glad two (soon more) competitors are pushing the frontier. He's attending his first OpenAI DevDay.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 用 Sonnet 5.5 做出了一个可玩的星际争霸关卡：扮演人族防守虫族，可造机枪兵、攻城坦克和大和舰，模型素材来自 Sketchfab，音乐由 Suno 生成，连宣传短片也是 Sonnet 做的。他还评论说 X 上对“OpenAI 被 Claude 5.5 碾压”或“Anthropic 被 Codex 打爆”的情绪反复横跳，他更高兴的是有两家（很快更多）在推前沿，大家都受益。他也将首次参加 OpenAI DevDay。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman teased tomorrow's DevDay: "We have found a new thing." No details yet.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 为明天的 DevDay 预热：“我们发现了一个新东西。”具体内容未透露。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared two updates: Vercel domain search now works without auth, especially handy for agents; and a mature workload full of "$formerProvider-isms" was migrated to Vercel with minimal intervention in under a week, yielding ~70% faster builds and ~75% faster paints, with two AI skills derived from the migration to be shared back.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布两条更新：一是 Vercel 域名搜索现在无需鉴权，对 agent 尤其友好；二是他们以尽量少人工干预的方式迁移了一个成熟站点来证明 Vercel 的性能，结果构建快约 70%、首屏绘制快约 75%，尽管负载里有大量前一家供应商的专属写法，整体工作不到一周完成，并从中提炼出两个 AI skills 将对外分享。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari took aim at investors preaching "distribution is a moat, so raise a lot," now that incumbents are flexing distribution. His advice: stay first-principles — find unfair advantages, build a high-retention product ideally with network effects, use capital as a weapon to compound rather than as destiny, and become self-sustaining because the money spigot will dry up. He also shared a video one-shotted by Opus 5.5.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 批评那些鼓吹“分发即护城河、所以要狂融资”的投资人：如今在位巨头正在秀分发肌肉。他主张回到第一性原理——找到不公平优势，做高留存、最好有网络效应的产品，把资本当作复利武器而非宿命，并尽快实现自我造血，因为“资金水龙头终会关上”。他还分享了一段由 Opus 5.5 一次生成的视频。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu, who designed Cursor, Notion and Stripe, showed a YouBike app he's been building for Taiwan: works in every city with YouBike, with docks, navigation, and live turn-by-turn voice directions.
items.insightZh: 曾主导 Cursor、Notion、Stripe 设计的 Ryo Lu 展示了自己最近做的一个台湾 YouBike 应用：覆盖所有有 YouBike 的城市，支持站点查询、导航和带语音的实时逐向指引。
